metadata.description: Claude Code, played as an adventure: soundtrack, hero and quest log.

plugins.name: miod
plugins.description: Generative music for Claude Code. Every task gets its own tune, and the mood follows what the agent is doing and how fast it spends tokens.

plugins.name: knightod
plugins.description: A pixel knight walks a narrow strip above the prompt while Claude works, fighting a monster for every edit and command, and saves the game when the task ends.

plugins.name: scrollod
plugins.description: Restyles the transcript: tool calls as one-liners, results only when they fail, replies that stand out, in a plain or game style
